features.name: health_severity_score
features.description: Ordinal severity of health condition mapped to a smooth scale where higher means worse health status.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a monotonic numeric projection of health for linear margin separation.

features.name: parents_pretention_score
features.description: Ordinal pretension level of parents from usual (low) to great_pret (high).
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth ordinal projection usable in linear combinations.

features.name: has_nurs_inadequacy_score
features.description: Ordinal nursery inadequacy from proper (best) through less_proper, improper, critical, very_crit (worst).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures graded nursery condition severity as a continuous linear feature.

features.name: housing_inconvenience_score
features.description: Ordinal housing inconvenience from convenient to critical.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous severity dimension for SVM margin.

features.name: finance_inconvenience_flag
features.description: Binary indicator that finance is inconvenient.
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct linear contribution from financial inconvenience.

features.name: social_problem_score
features.description: Ordinal social condition score from nonprob to problematic.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth ordinal feature reflecting social difficulty.

features.name: form_incompleteness_score
features.description: Ordinal family form structure score, higher meaning less standard family form.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides continuous projection of family structure for linear separability.

features.name: children_count_numeric
features.description: Numeric children count with 'more' mapped to 4, normalized to [0,1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Numeric ordinal usable directly in linear projection.

features.name: overall_household_strain_composite
features.description: Weighted composite summing key severity scores (housing, finance, social, has_nurs) reflecting overall household strain.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregated linear-friendly severity composite captures cumulative risk along one axis.
features.formula: np.where(housing == 'convenient', 0.0, np.where(housing == 'less_conv', 0.5, 1.0)) + np.where(finance == 'inconv', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(social == 'nonprob', 0.0, np.where(social == 'slightly_prob', 0.5, 1.0)) + np.where(has_nurs == 'proper', 0.0, np.where(has_nurs == 'less_proper', 0.25, np.where(has_nurs == 'improper', 0.5, np.where(has_nurs == 'critical', 0.75, 1.0))))

features.name: health_blocks_recommendation
features.description: Indicator that health is at the worst category, which historically dominates non-recommendation decisions in such ordinal nursery rules.
features.expected_model_benefit: Single high-impact binary dimension supports clean linear separation.

features.name: child_load_per_strain_ratio
features.description: Ratio of children count to household strain composite plus a small constant; reflects child-load relative to overall difficulty.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio interaction useful as a smooth continuous SVM feature.
features.formula: (np.where(children == '1', 1.0, np.where(children == '2', 2.0, np.where(children == '3', 3.0, 4.0)))) / (1.0 + np.where(housing == 'convenient', 0.0, np.where(housing == 'less_conv', 0.5, 1.0)) + np.where(finance == 'inconv', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(social == 'nonprob', 0.0, np.where(social == 'slightly_prob', 0.5, 1.0)))

features.name: family_suitability_judgment
features.description: Semantic judgment score of overall family suitability for nursery placement based on the joint configuration of parents pretension, family form, children count, and social condition, on a 0 (least suitable) to 1 (most suitable) scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-formulaic gestalt suitability that complements ordinal projections in linear models.
